rule: Before every new entry, value the account using realized P&L plus each open ETH position marked at the completed entry-minute close. Spend exactly one fifth of that equity, subject to available cash and the existing five-slot, no-leverage constraint. Existing positions are never resized.
notes: This is continuous symmetric compounding: losses lower subsequent order sizes and gains raise them. It is a sizing replay, not a change to the current live strategy.
